title: Fourier coefficients of a level polynomial
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be nonnegative integers, and let $T$ be a finite set of coordinates in $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$. On the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, form the polynomial by summing the coordinate monomials over all $k$-element coordinate sets. Its Fourier coefficient at $T$ is $1$ if $|T|=k$, and is $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$
